item.title: ANTONBLAST final update coming this month
item.description: Indie developer Summitsphere has announced a final update for ANTONBLAST, their hand-animated retro platformer. ANTONBLAST is getting its final content update later this month, on December 18th.

item.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment Review
item.description: Can a direct prequel to Tears of the Kingdom work as an epic Musou melee war game? Find out in our Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment review!
